label: Godot 4
resourceRootHint: Folder relative to the Godot project root, for example smap or levels/world. Leave empty for the project root.
invalidRoot: The resource folder must be a valid relative path: {path}
invalidImage: PNG could not be read or is unsuitable for Godot: {path}
imageTooSmall: PNG is too small for its tileset grid: {path}
nativeSizeMismatch: {tileset}: native tile is {nativeWidth} × {nativeHeight} px, map cell is {cellWidth} × {cellHeight} px. Godot export requires matching sizes; pixels are never rescaled.
cellSizeOutOfRange: {map}: Godot cell dimensions must be between 1 and 16384 px.
rectangularTranspose: {map}: transposed rectangular tiles are unsupported. Use square cells.
invalidTiles: {map}: a tileset is missing or a tile reference is invalid. Fix it before exporting.
overflow: {map}: a cell coordinate or atlas identifier exceeds Godot limits (−32768–32767; identifiers 0–32767).
fileConflict: Multiple sources use the same export filename: {path}. Rename the map or PNG file.
inconsistentTileset: {tileset}: tileset definitions differ between the selected maps. Make the maps use the same source.
differentCellSizes: {map}: maps sharing a Godot TileSet must have the same cell size. Export different sizes separately.
noMaps: No map was selected for export.
